name: Yoruba
intro: Food from South West Nigeria: rich pepper stews, efo riro, amala with ewedu and gbegiri, and the party jollof everyone argues about.
dishes: Efo riro, amala and ewedu, ofada stew, gbegiri

name: Igbo
intro: Food from South East Nigeria: ofe onugbu, oha soup, abacha and nkwobi, built on bold soups and fresh leaves.
dishes: Ofe onugbu, oha soup, abacha, nkwobi

name: Hausa / Northern
intro: Food from Northern Nigeria: suya, tuwo shinkafa, miyan kuka and masa, with plenty of spice, grains and grilled meat.
dishes: Suya, tuwo shinkafa, miyan kuka, masa

name: Niger Delta
intro: Food from the Niger Delta: banga soup, fisherman soup, starch and pepper soup, full of fresh fish and palm fruit.
dishes: Banga soup, fisherman soup, starch, plantain pottage

name: Edo
intro: Food from Edo State: owo soup, black soup and groundnut soup, with deep flavours from local spices and leaves.
dishes: Owo soup, black soup, groundnut soup

name: Efik / Ibibio
intro: Food from Cross River and Akwa Ibom: afang, edikang ikong and atama soup, known for generous greens and seafood.
dishes: Afang, edikang ikong, atama soup, ekpang nkukwo
